fields.FIR_Description: During the evening of 2025-12-26, around 17:45, the complainant learned that a document with altered details had been submitted for a transaction worth Rs. 5,00,000 near Palar Layout Market Road in Karur, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-12-29. The complaint was lodged by Senthil Rajan (9000000019). The complainant alleged that Nithin Subramani may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000354. The complainant mentioned physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Forged papers reportedly used to process a transaction.
fields.Keywords: forgery, forged document, suspect, mobile number, evening, market road, documents
